title: custom:sun-azimuth-card-pro
description: Where the sun is around the house today: a sky dial seen from above, a 3D scene with the house, its shadow and the sky dome, or a compass ring, plus the sides of the house the sun shines on. Computed from the Home Assistant coordinates.

house.description: How the house stands and what its sides are called

rotation.description: Degrees clockwise from north that the north side's outward normal points to

sides.description: Your own names for the sides (the defaults follow the profile language)

camera.description: 3D view: the bearing the camera looks toward (180 = standing north of the house, looking south)

camera_slider.description: 3D view: a slider under the plot to orbit the scene; the value is not saved

hover_preview.description: Hovering or tapping a side's timeline in the footer shows the sun at that time in the plot

show_house.description: Dial and 3D: the line naming the sides in the sun and what comes next

show_events.description: Dial and 3D: the sunrise, solar noon and sunset row

show_sides.description: The sides of the house footer with each side's sun window today
